name: Ring Face Pull
steps: Hold gymnastic rings at chest height, lean back into a straight angled body line, and extend your arms forward with palms down.
Brace your core and glutes so your torso stays rigid from head to heels.
Pull the rings smoothly toward your forehead while flaring your elbows high and rotating your forearms back.
Squeeze your upper back and rear delts briefly, then extend your arms slowly back to the starting lean.
tips: Drive your thumbs backward past your ears at the top so your shoulders externally rotate fully.
Step your feet slightly forward or back to adjust difficulty while keeping every rep smooth.
